scope: Add one operational verify:feature command that runs the fast deterministic suites, produces current build outputs without repeating those checks, smokes the built server, and runs the five-case canonical browser gate.
Add one verify:daily alias for the unchanged complete verify:full gate and establish one end-of-day execution cadence.

Update repository and agent instructions so normal feature delivery runs verify:feature while the full matrix, performance, security, audit, and release checks run at the daily checkpoint or an explicit release boundary.
Add executable tooling assertions that prevent the quick gate from silently becoming the full gate or the daily alias from drifting away from verify:full.

Limit tracked outputs to AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/evidence/wp-014h.json, docs/planning/implementation_plan.md, docs/process/development_workflow.md, package.json, and tests/tooling/verification-cadence.test.js.
non_goals: No reduction in full-suite projects, expected-skip accounting, retries, worker limits, visual thresholds, timing budgets, security checks, audit coverage, or release evidence.
No gameplay, simulation, client, server, protocol, reward, authority, asset, dependency, package-lock, executor, or GitHub release-CI behavior change.
No player observation, physical-device session, Lane G/Lane M execution, Stage C work, ProductAuthority, P5, placement, or landfall claim.

check_results.detail: All 70 tooling tests passed in 1.43 seconds, including the new feature-gate composition and exact daily-alias assertions.

The complete per-feature gate passed in about one minute: compliance, types, 70 tooling, 38 protocol, 32 simulation, 11 Loomkeeper, 9 Relic, 24 combat, 5 Practice, 22 identity, and 24 reward tests; current server/client outputs and deterministic build proof; built smoke; and five canonical Chromium browser checks, whose browser phase completed in 35.3 seconds.
All asset, runtime-inventory, generation-component, import-boundary, package-license, work-package, and clean-room gates passed with 48 work-package records.
0 vulnerabilities; package-lock.json and dependency identities remain unchanged.

Tooling proves verify:daily is exactly npm run verify:full. A bounded startup probe entered verify:full and its verify:fast stage successfully, then was intentionally interrupted before the full suite as directed by the owner. Active local automation worms-port-daily-verification is scheduled daily at 22:00 and reports without modifying or fixing the repository.

The final tracked path set matches the seven-path allowlist. Review confirmed the quick command retains deterministic, build, smoke, and browser evidence; the daily alias retains the complete gate; GitHub release CI, gameplay, dependencies, assets, policies, thresholds, and manifests are unchanged; whitespace validation passed.

reviews.reviewer: Codex primary-agent cadence and scope review
reviews.detail: Reviewed script composition, duplicate-check avoidance, daily alias integrity, scheduling prompt boundaries, agent instructions, exact output scope, and unchanged full-suite authority.

skipped_checks: The complete verify:daily suite was not rerun during implementation at the owner's direction. Its startup and exact alias were proven; WP-014G's immediately preceding full matrix and performance evidence remain the current full-run baseline until the scheduled end-of-day checkpoint.
Real Android/iOS and Nimiq Pay WebView testing was not run because this package changes verification cadence and repository tooling only.
residual_risks: The end-of-day automation requires the configured local host to be available; the manual npm run verify:daily command remains the fallback.
A red quick gate still blocks feature delivery, while a red daily gate remains actionable debt and must not be normalized as an expected failure.
Physical Android/iOS and Nimiq Pay WebView behavior remain separate user-operated acceptance.
